name: ecosignal-campaign-impact-and-trust-analytics
description: EcoSignal is a sustainability campaign impact and trust analytics platform for campaign performance, green claim proofing, evidence review, budget efficiency, and executive reporting.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.audit:check: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix server audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --audit-level=high
